label: Aristotle, Metaphysics IX.6, 1048a30-35: A… supports In a subject capable of r, privation of r…
note: Metaphysics IX.6, 1048a30-35: the knower who is not contemplating, if able to contemplate, is a knower potentially. It bears on the premise through a capable subject lacking the act; the passage does not use privation, and that privation in a capable subject is exactly the lack of the act is the analyst's.
